snippet.title: RECHARGED
snippet.description:
Download: https://github.com/previouslevelgames/recharged
Mario Strikers Community: https://dsc.gg/mariostrikers
Music by J0el: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=To-8L2CpM0E

Recharged is not so-called "AI slop". Real developers are working alongside some of the most experienced Mario Strikers Charged players to deliver the best possible gameplay experience.

We are not affiliated with Nintendo in any way. Recharged is a project made by fans, for fans.
